lessons.pattern: Worker memory exhaustion during multi-page PDF batch processing
lessons.recommended_action: Recycle worker subprocess after processing 50 large PDF documents (max_tasks_per_child=50)

lessons.pattern: Database connection pool starvation under concurrent search traffic
lessons.recommended_action: Drain idle connection pool sockets and enforce 5000ms statement timeouts on search sessions

lessons.pattern: Gemini API rate limiting during morning batch ingestion
lessons.recommended_action: Dynamically pace token consumption via client-side token-bucket and fall back to secondary model

lessons.pattern: Redis broker socket disconnect during background AOF snapshot
lessons.recommended_action: Reconnect socket with jittered backoff and set vm.overcommit_memory=1
